titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Travel and accommodation: Listening comprehension

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Travel and accommodation. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

texto: Listening at check-in and hotel reception: train your ear to pick up whether the receptionist asks about your booking («จองห้องพักไว้ไหมครับ») or confirms where your luggage is. When you hear «มีห้องว่างไหมคะ», notice the high interrogative tone of «คะ», commonly used in polite questions.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «เงื่อนไขการเช็กอินและการเช็กเอาต์มีรายละเอียดระบุไว้ในใบยืนยันการจอง» express?

opciones.texto: The check-in and check-out conditions are stated on the booking voucher.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «เงื่อนไขการเช็กอินและการเช็กเอาต์มีรายละเอียดระบุไว้ในใบยืนยันการจอง» from the text.

opciones.texto: The breakfast buffet and hotel facilities increase the guest's well-being.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Requesting an airport transfer saves time on the return trip.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the enquiry. What does the guest arriving at reception want to know?

piezas.audio: มีห้องว่างไหมคะ

opciones.texto: Whether there is any room available at the hotel (มีห้องว่างไหมคะ)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: «ห้องว่าง» means an unoccupied or available room.

opciones.texto: Where they can buy a new suitcase
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not mention buying suitcases.

opciones.texto: What time the breakfast buffet is served
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not ask about meals.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
